newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Omega buys two units for 75 mln rand.
newsitem.headline: Omega buys two units for 75 mln rand.

text.p: Omega Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it had bought the whole of Tek Finance and Consumer Electronic Equipment Company (Pty) Ltd (Pioneer) from Plessey Corporation Ltd for 75 million rand.
The purchase is with effect from the last business day after the date by which all purchase conditions are fulfilled.

Purchase conditions include an indication by the Competition Board that it would not investigate the Tek acquisition. The price will be settled by the allotment of 17,263 million Omega shares in renounceable form and the balance by cash.
Omega and Plessey will also sign an agreement whereby Plessey would continue to manufacture and assemble Telefunken television products for Omega.
Omega said the acquisition complemented its organic growth opportunities and would bolster its product range in the upper market brand.
The acquisions will have an effect of raising its earnings per share to 44.6 cents from 30.2 cents in the year to March 1996, prior to the acquisitions.
